entries.name: Current vehicle speed
entries.description: Ego-vehicle speed from CAN bus or GNSS; displayed as an instrument number, never as a limit.

entries.name: Vehicle dimensions
entries.description: Length, width and height used to evaluate clearance and width restrictions.

entries.name: Ground clearance
entries.description: Underbody clearance used to rate humps, stones and potholes.

entries.name: Vehicle type
entries.description: Vehicle class used to personalise severity.

entries.name: Trailer or heavy-load context
entries.description: Trailer or heavy load affecting braking and gradients.

entries.name: Vehicle approach direction
entries.description: Heading relative to a hazard; hazards may apply only to one direction.

entries.name: Braking capability
entries.description: Estimated braking performance, when available from the vehicle.

entries.name: Vehicle sensor availability
entries.description: Which sensors (camera, IMU, radar) are available to detect hazards.
